subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Data Quality as Operational Risk
description: A short lesson to help you apply Data Quality as Operational Risk.

hook.text: A risk model says you're safe. But the data feeding it is wrong. Your confidence is built on bad numbers.

buildup.text: Data quality issues — duplicates, missing fields, stale records — silently corrupt every downstream decision.

discovery.text: IBM estimated poor data quality costs the US economy $3.1 trillion per year across all industries.

twist.text: Companies spend millions on AI models but pennies on the data that feeds them. Garbage in, garbage out.

climax.text: Data quality is an invisible operational risk. By the time you notice, the bad decisions are already made.

punchline.text: Bad data. Good model. Wrong answer. Every time.

quiz.question: How much does poor data quality cost the US economy annually?
